text:
sam: Quick follow-up from today's MHA layout sync — we need a decision on default QKV packing and how kernel selector should route NHWC vs NCHW and contiguous vs planar QKV. TL;DR: perf favors packed NHWC contiguous QKV for fp16 on Ampere; some quantized kernels require planar. Thoughts?

julia: Agree on packed NHWC perf. Benchmarks I ran on A100 (fp16, seq 512, batch 8) showed ~18% lower p99 with NHWC+contiguous QKV vs NCHW interleaved.

kevin: Curious about KV cache and head-wise ops. If we switch default layout we need to minimize copy-on-cache-fill. Any ideas for in-place adapter?

maya: propose adding a small runtime adapter that translates planar->contig at first use and then pins blob. That keeps kernel ABI simple. Cost of one copy per session start is tiny vs token cost.

ryan: +1 to adapter but need a flag to opt-in for low-mem devices. Could be `layout.adapt=true|false` in runtime config.

sam: @julia can you paste the perf numbers? want to include in the RFC follow-up.

julia: pasted below:
```
A100 fp16 512x8
NHWC+contig QKV: p50 28ms p99 46ms
NCHW interleaved: p50 33ms p99 56ms
copy-on-adapt overhead: ~6ms at session start
```

kevin: Is the ~6ms copy per session or per model? sessions vs inference vs warmup matters.

julia: session start only. warm starts negligible.

maya: for quantized kernels (int8) our current kernel implementations expect planar q/k/v because they use per-head quant params. Rewriting those kernels to support contiguous would add maintenance burden.

sam: So options:
1) Default NHWC+contig for fp16/float kernels, route quantized to planar kernels.
2) Keep API shape-agnostic, require kernels to register supported layouts and let selector pick. But that increases selector complexity and ABI surface.

ryan: option 1 seems pragmatic. Option 2 is cleaner long-term but needs selector changes: layout capability flags, fallback chains, and more test matrices.

kevin: also consider memory alignment: contiguous QKV changes strides -> some CUDA kernels need 64B alignment for best loads. We should document alignment guarantees in the runtime contract.

maya: agree. propose runtime promise: if layout=NHWC+contig then stride align to 64 bytes and base pointer aligned to 256 for cuBLAS matmul-friendly paths.

sam: I'll draft a short RFC follow-up with that plan: default NHWC+contig for float, quantized -> planar, runtime adapter for legacy planar-only models, config flag layout.adapt, and alignment contract. any objections?

kevin: no objections but add tests for cold-start overhead and KV-cache copy avoidance.

julia: also add a small perf harness to run across seq lengths 32/128/512 and batch 1/8/16.

infra-bot: RFC 'mha-layout-runtime-adapter' updated by sam — link: https://redwood/rfcs/456

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll post the draft in #eng-runtime for review within an hour. :thumbsup:
